articles.title: Council Delays Vote on Yardley Drive Bike Repair Clinic
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Yardley Drive disagreed about cost and timing.
body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.

articles.title: Kiera Kozak, 96, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Kiera Kozak for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Kiera Kozak spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program in his or her name. Kiera Kozak died in May at home on Quarry Terrace, at the age of 96.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting.

Please keep the bike repair clinic in the budget. Many of us on Pine Road use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Pine Road for 21 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group has made.
Esther Cifuentes, Tannery Flats
